name: DRIFT: To Sink or Swim
source:
What do you become when you stop pretending to be who you were? How much would you risk to save someone who's already given up?

DRIFT is a story-driven visual novel about identity, embracing change, and finding connections in unexpected places. After a reckless night out, you play as Noah, a middle-aged cat working an unfulfilling office job who finds himself entangled with a mysterious aquatic test subject known only as Shark. What starts as a chance encounter soon becomes a journey of introspection, loyalty, and self-definition.

[From [url=https://korbu-verifed.itch.io/drift]Itch.io[/url]]
